craftinginfo-starterguide-text:
Tabletop Games: Starter Guide

Create generic board
Once you create Generic board, place it on the solid surface and follow instructions in tooltip.

Create schematic
Made by interacting with any pigment on parchment placed on the solid surface.

Create pieces
With schematic in active hand, press toolmodeselect key (Tool Mode) to open menu for creating pieces.
craftinginfo-custompiecesguide-text:
Tabletop Games: Custom Pieces Guide

With schematic in active hand, press toolmodeselect key (Tool Mode), find a mode with a chisel tool icon, then follow instructions in the description.

To change dimension limit, use following commands:
/worldconfig tabletopgames_chiseledPieceMaxUp : Sets the maximum number of chiseled blocks that can be added above
/worldconfig tabletopgames_chiseledPieceMaxDown : Sets the maximum number of chiseled blocks that can be added below
craftinginfo-customboardsguide-text:
Tabletop Games: Custom Boards Guide

Hitbox = slot.
Note that each slot can hold only one item.

Step 1: Create a chiseled block for hitboxes
Chisel voxel pillars using different materials for each hitbox. The game optimizes voxels horizontally, and using voxel pillars is the only way to prevent this optimization.
For example, if you want hitboxes arranged in a checkerboard pattern, you only need two different materials.

Step 2 (Optional): Create a chiseled block for textures
Chisel anything you want, seriously, there are no limitations at this step. Just make sure the block is facing in the same direction as the block from the previous step.

Final Step: Create the board
With a schematic in your active hand, press the toolmodeselect key (Tool Mode), find the mode with a chisel tool icon, and follow the instructions in the description.

Additional Info
Once you've created a chiseled board, follow the tooltips in the block’s description for more details.
interactionsinfo-playingcard-text:
Tabletop Games: Playing Card - Interactions

Cards in active hand can be shuffled using tabletopgames:shuffle.

Inventory slot
Merging Cards: Click on a card with another card to merge them.
Note: Only single cards can be merged, not stacks.

Tool Mode Menu
Take a card from slot: rightmouse.
Click a card with another card to exchange cards.
Add a card before another card: ctrl + rightmouse.
Add a card after another card: shift + rightmouse.

Placed card(s)
Take a card from a stack: shift + rightmouse.
Put a card onto placed card(s): shift + rightmouse.
Put a flipped card onto placed card(s): ctrl + rightmouse.
Place a card on solid surface: shift + rightmouse.
Place a flipped card on solid surface: shift + ctrl + rightmouse.
